findings.title: TECOS addition still marked not applied in the new notice ledger
findings.why: The known TECOS status contradiction persists in the new Changes tab. Its ledger marks the primary-outcome addition as not applied, while the committed review includes TECOS and serves the four-trial result.
findings.fix: Reconcile the displayed application status with current trial membership. Preserve the signed notice verbatim, but distinguish any historical hold from the current served state.
